concepts.name: Superhero

concepts.name: FullName
concepts.definition: The full (real) name of a superhero.

concepts.name: Publisher
concepts.definition: The publishing company that owns the superhero.

concepts.name: EyeColour
concepts.definition: The eye colour of a superhero.

concepts.name: Height
concepts.definition: The height of a superhero in centimetres.

concepts.name: Weight
concepts.definition: The weight of a superhero in kilograms.

concepts.name: Attribute
concepts.definition: A numeric attribute score of a superhero (e.g. strength, intelligence, speed).

concepts.name: Superpower
concepts.definition: A special ability possessed by a superhero.

caveats.statement: Some superheroes have NULL full_name, which can cause missing values in name-based queries.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE full_name IS NULL;

caveats.statement: Some superheroes have weight_kg = 0 or NULL, which can skew weight-based analysis.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE weight_kg = 0 OR weight_kg IS NULL;

caveats.statement: Some superheroes have no publisher assigned, which can cause missing values in publisher-based analysis.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id IS NULL;

caveats.statement: Some superheroes have no race assigned, which can cause missing values in race-based analysis.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE race_id IS NULL;

caveats.statement: Some superheroes have no attributes recorded in hero_attribute, which can cause missing values in attribute-based analysis.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT hero_id FROM hero_attribute);

caveats.statement: Some superheroes have no superpowers recorded in hero_power, which can cause missing values in power-based analysis.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT hero_id FROM hero_power);
